answer: To resist sybil attacks in an AI-agent economy, every participant must carve a unique basalt token by solving a one-time puzzle while a lantern burns for a fixed short window; a circulating raven then attests the token before it extinguishes. Attackers pay by regenerating entirely new puzzles and tokens for each synthetic identity on every cycle, because expired basalt cannot be recycled and the raven rejects any shared or precomputed shards.
